# Linkker

> Linkker saves links from anywhere (Chrome, iPhone, Android), sorts them into smart AI categories and finds them in seconds. Private links can sit behind a PIN or biometrics, and links and files move between phone and computer over your own Wi-Fi.

## Pages
- [Home](https://linkker.space/): what Linkker does and where to get it
- [Support](https://linkker.space/support): help and contact
- [Blog](https://linkker.space/blog/): hand-picked free websites and AI tools

Hand-picked lists of free websites and tools. Each page opens with quick picks, then one honest card per site.
